rows.expected_result: Actual drawable format, view scale, physical size and no Y inversion.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Recover lost or unsupported surface during creation.
rows.native_mapping: Treat headless, minimized and suspended as benign and permit retry after a newer snapshot; reject malformed configuration before mutating active state.
rows.expected_result: Non-layer, invalid metadata, nil default device and restoration.

rows.contract: Acquire waits for usable drawable and distinguishes normal/suboptimal/lost/out-of-date.
rows.native_mapping: Single producer performs bounded native nextDrawable; nil is typed backpressure, changed native size/format is typed retry, and stale device/work generation is unavailable.
rows.expected_result: Hold all drawables, occlude then acquire again, resize between acquire/present and advance device lease.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Present synchronizes acquired image and observable presentation with queued rendering.
rows.native_mapping: Validate lease before recording. Native scheduler routes waitForDrawable, commit, signalDrawable, then normal or minimum-duration present. Keep device, layer, drawable and texture alive.
rows.expected_result: Actual native known-answer drawable clear, ticket and present callback behavior across resize and close.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Select nonlinear sRGB-compatible RGBA8 or BGRA8 presentation format.
rows.native_mapping: Use CAMetalLayer BGRA8 unorm, mark output content as sRGB; don't ask native to apply an extra format transfer on already display-coded bytes.
rows.expected_result: Audit native pixelFormat/colorspace; compare known colors in live compositing.

rows.contract: Select FIFO, mailbox, immediate and fallback using settings and low refresh.

rows.expected_result: 64 host policy cases and 30/60/120-Hz physical cadence and latest queued frames.

rows.contract: Configure size using current surface capabilities and device limits; prefer identity orientation and opacity.

rows.contract: Destroy old image/semaphore backing and rebuild native pool tracking.

rows.expected_result: Repeated reconfiguration and close with committed and abandoned move-only leases.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.expected_result: Compile the native caller and run deterministic host checks; add physical GPU ownership and pacing coverage in Phase 073.
